rules.statement: A mobile-video-device operation and management policy may be included in the privacy policy.

If included, cover: (1) operating basis and purpose; (2) number of devices; (3) manager, department, persons with access; (4) filming hours, retention period, storage place, processing method; (5) how and where footage is checked; (6) handling of access and other requests; (7) technical, managerial and physical protection; (8) other necessary matters.
Where footage is kept, describe de-identification (e.g. blurring faces and plates) in the processing method if used.

goodPatterns: Example context: delivery robots; operating basis cites PIPA 25-2(1)1 with 15(1)4; table of operating hours, retention, storage, blurring before storage.

commonDefects.defect: Robots, drones or vehicle cameras film people but no mobile-device block and no separate policy.

warnNote: Handling = warn: manual review of the operating basis is always required.
extractionHints: delivery robot, drone, dashcam, body cam, autonomous vehicle

DEC:25(1).note: guideline text applies it to mobile devices too (L2773)

needsVerification.note: The guideline points mobile-device items to Decree 25(1) (L2773); confirm the decree article for mobile devices at law level before citing it in clauses.
